title: ActionIntentToken
description: Governed Action Intent Token proposal with Cloud KMS ECDSA P-256 signature and Four-Eyes state.

intent_id.description: Unique UUID identifying the action intent proposal

parameters.description: Validated parameters matching canonical action specification

evidence_refs.description: Evidentiary citations proving the necessity of the proposed action

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the token

nonce.description: Single-use cryptographic nonce preventing replay attacks

issued_at.description: UTC timestamp when the token was created

expires_at.description: UTC timestamp after which the token is invalid (15 min lifespan)

requester_agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent or service proposing the mutation

kms_key_id.description: Cloud KMS asymmetric key ID used for signing

signature.description: Base64 ASN.1 DER ECDSA P-256 signature over canonical RFC 8785 JSON

causal_context.description: Covariate vector at proposal time for AIPW debiasing

requires_dual_approval.description: True if Four-Eyes dual approval is legally mandatory

ledger_seq.description: Assigned monotonic integer sequence number in atomic ledger

execution_receipt_id.description: Linked execution receipt ID upon commit
